item.tib: bka' gsang mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud gu ru'i thugs bcud las zhing skyongs seng gdong khros ma'i zlog pa mtshon cha'i 'khor lo'i phyag bzhes
item.coloph: zhing skyongs seng gdong zlog pa mtshon cha 'khor lo'i/ 'phrin las kyi go rim phyag tu bzhes chog pa'i zin bris tho rtsom 'di/ sprul sku sangs rgyas gling pas/ chu glang hor zla lnga pa'i tshes brgyad bzang po la/ gdan sa smin grol khrod kyi yang dben lta ba klong yangs nas/ thun 'tshams sug bris bgyis pa legs pa'i 'phrin las rgya chen po 'grub gyur cig/
